versions.changelog:
- Updated description for improved clarity and added English/Chinese summary.
- Changed project homepage URL to GitHub repo.
- Removed obsolete "skill-card.md" file and added ".gitignore".
- Revised and clarified documentation in SKILL.md for API usage, workflows, and features.
- No functional (code/API) changes; documentation and metadata improvements only.

Initial release.

- Introduces AI-powered file organization for Firefly AI Folder: analyze, categorize, smart-rename, tag, search, and remove duplicates.
- Communicates with the desktop client to query analysis status, search files, generate organization plans, and view dashboard data.
- Supports managing virtual directories and smart organization workflows, with multi-language output and strict user notification rules.
- Provides detailed workflow and API usage instructions for workspace listing, analysis progress, file search, analysis data lookup, plan generation/application, and system overview.

- Added comprehensive usage instructions and API workflow to SKILL.md, covering workspace queries, file searches, analysis progress, virtual directory management, and solution generation.
- Detailed strict procedural rules for error handling and multilingual output when discovering the API endpoint.
- Clarified API endpoints, data structures, and response formatting for dashboard and organizational features.
- Outlined requirements for AI-based organization planning, with explicit step-by-step guidance for plan generation and application.
- Enhanced documentation for encoding, data transmission, and system state reporting.

Initial release of AI Folder Organize – your smart assistant for file management:

- Communicate with Firefly AI Folder desktop client to analyze, categorize, tag, and search files.
- Monitor file analysis progress and manage multiple workspaces.
- Generate, preview, and apply smart organization plans (虚拟目录/整理方案).
- Search files, display file analysis details, and summarize system status with structured text and emoji.
- Full support for workflows including API discovery, workspace queries, and organization strategy generation.
